eyebrow: Microsoft Azure Administration, Compute & Storage · Chapter 6
subtitle: Lesson 22 · Azure CLI & PowerShell Administration

code:
az vm create \
  --resource-group rg-cli-demo \
  --name vm-cli-demo \
  --image Ubuntu2204 \
  --admin-username azureuser \
  --generate-ssh-keys \
  --size Standard_B1s
caption: Image, disk, NIC, networking, and SSH auth — all in this single call.
Returns the VM, its disk, NIC, public IP, and VNet — every resource type.
Deleting the group removes every resource inside it, no scavenger hunt.

subtitle: The same tasks, through the Az module's Verb-Noun cmdlets.
